summary: Learn prompt engineering, brand QA, and AI content workflows in a practical 5-day course. Build assets, governance, and reporting tools.
lede: Generative AI for content, marketing, and creative teams covers using large language models to plan, draft, adapt, and review marketing assets. Designed for professionals who create, review, approve, or optimize content, it addresses producing assets while maintaining editorial oversight. You’ll practice writing prompts and testing variants, checking AI-generated copy against brand voice and editorial requirements, and structuring content repurposing, approval, and campaign measurement workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who create, review, approve, or optimize marketing content and need practical generative AI for content, marketing, and creative teams training.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in content creation, digital marketing, brand management, communications, or creative production. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable editing copy, reviewing brand assets, and working with digital collaboration tools such as shared documents and content calendars. A basic understanding of campaign planning, audience segmentation, and brand guidelines will help you get more from the hands-on exercises. Advanced AI concepts are taught at an operational application level, not as technical engineering.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
